official: 羽村市家庭的保育事業等の設備及び運営に関する基準を定める条例及び羽村市特定教育・保育施設及び特定地域型保育事業の運営に関する基準を定める条例の一部を改正する条例
name: 満3歳以上限定の小規模保育基準を追加
summary: 満3歳以上限定小規模保育事業が新たに設けられ、国の府省令にこの事業の基準が加わりました。この議案は、基準に合わせて市の2つの条例を改正します。
changes: 満3歳以上限定小規模保育事業に関する基準を条例に加える
who: 満3歳以上限定小規模保育事業を利用する子どもと保護者
同事業を運営する事業者
why: 満3歳以上限定小規模保育事業の創設に伴い、関係する府省令に基準が加えられたためと、市は説明しています。

en.name: Adds standards for small-scale childcare for children aged 3 and over only
en.official: Ordinance Partially Amending the Hamura City Ordinance Establishing Standards for Equipment and Operation of Home-Based Childcare Services, etc., and the Hamura City Ordinance Establishing Standards for the Operation of Designated Educational and Childcare Facilities and Designated Community-Based Childcare Services
en.summary: A new type of small-scale childcare for children aged 3 and over only has been established, and standards for this service have been added to a national ministerial ordinance. This bill amends two of the city's ordinances to align them with those standards.
changes: Adds standards for small-scale childcare for children aged 3 and over only to the ordinances
who: Children and parents who use small-scale childcare for children aged 3 and over only
en.why: The city says this is because standards were added to the relevant Cabinet Office and ministry ordinances following the establishment of small-scale childcare for children aged 3 and over only.
